source.text: Διώκετε τὴν ἀγάπην, ζηλοῦτε δὲ τὰ πνευματικά, μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε.

records.literal_gloss: Pursue the love, be zealous but [for] the spiritual [things], rather but that you may prophesy.

en.L: Pursue love, and be zealous for the spiritual [gifts], but especially that you may prophesy.
en.B: Strive for love, and set your hearts on spiritual gifts, most of all on prophesying.
en.R: Above everything else, work hard at loving others. And try hard to receive the gifts that the Spirit gives, most of all the gift of prophecy, speaking messages from God.

fr.L: Poursuivez l’amour, et aspirez aux [dons] spirituels, mais surtout à prophétiser.
fr.B: Faites de l’amour votre but, et désirez vivement les dons spirituels, surtout celui de prophétiser.
fr.R: Plus que tout, efforcez-vous d’aimer les autres. Et cherchez de tout votre cœur à recevoir les dons que l’Esprit accorde, surtout le don de prophétie : dire des messages qui viennent de Dieu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} el amor, y {{plural_you:procuren con celo|procurad con celo}} los [dones] espirituales, pero sobre todo que {{plural_you:profeticen|profeticéis}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} el amor y {{plural_you:anhelen|anhelad}} los dones espirituales, sobre todo el de profetizar.
es.R: Por encima de todo, {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} por amar a los demás. Y {{plural_you:procuren|procurad}} recibir los dones que da el Espíritu, sobre todo el don de profecía, que es hablar mensajes de parte de Dios.

sw.L: Ufuateni upendo, na mwe na shauku ya [karama] za kiroho, lakini hasa kwamba mpate kutabiri.
sw.B: Jitahidini kupata upendo, na mtamani sana karama za kiroho, hasa karama ya kutabiri.
sw.R: Kuliko yote, jitahidini kuwapenda wengine. Pia jitahidini kupokea karama ambazo Roho hutoa, hasa karama ya unabii, yaani kusema ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.

vi.L: Hãy theo đuổi tình yêu thương, và hãy khao khát các [ân tứ] thuộc linh, nhưng nhất là để anh chị em được nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Hãy theo đuổi tình yêu thương, và hãy hết lòng ước ao các ân tứ thuộc linh, nhất là ân tứ nói tiên tri.
vi.R: Trên hết mọi sự, hãy cố gắng yêu thương người khác. Và hãy cố gắng để nhận được những ân tứ mà Thánh Linh ban cho, nhất là ân tứ nói tiên tri, tức là nói ra những sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 사랑을 추구하고, 영적인 [은사들]을 열심히 구하되, 특히 예언하기를 [구하십시오].
ko.B: 사랑을 따라 힘써 나아가십시오. 그리고 영적인 은사를 간절히 사모하되, 무엇보다도 예언하기를 사모하십시오.
ko.R: 무엇보다도 다른 사람을 사랑하는 일에 힘쓰십시오. 그리고 성령께서 주시는 은사를 받으려고 힘쓰십시오. 그 가운데서도 하나님께 받은 말씀을 전하는 예언의 은사를 가장 바라십시오.

pt.L: Busquem o amor e sejam zelosos pelos [dons] espirituais, mas sobretudo para que profetizem.
pt.B: Empenhem-se em ter amor e desejem de todo o coração os dons espirituais, principalmente o de profetizar.
pt.R: Acima de tudo, empenhem-se em amar os outros. E esforcem-se para receber os dons que o Espírito dá, principalmente o dom de profecia, que é falar mensagens que vêm de Deus.

am.L: ፍቅርን ተከታተሉ፤ መንፈሳዊ [ስጦታዎችንም] በቅናት ፈልጉ፤ ከሁሉ ይልቅ ግን ትንቢት እንድትናገሩ [ፈልጉ]።
am.B: ፍቅርን ለማግኘት ትጉ፤ ልባችሁንም በመንፈስ ስጦታዎች ላይ አድርጉ፤ ከሁሉም በላይ ደግሞ ትንቢት በመናገር ላይ።
am.R: ከሁሉ በላይ ሌሎችን ለመውደድ ትጉ። መንፈስ ቅዱስ የሚሰጣቸውን ስጦታዎች ለመቀበልም ጥረት አድርጉ፤ ከሁሉም በላይ ደግሞ የትንቢትን ስጦታ፣ ማለትም ከእግዚአብሔር የሆነውን መልእክት የመናገርን ስጦታ።

hi.L: प्रेम के पीछे लगे रहो, और आत्मिक [वरदानों] की धुन में रहो, पर विशेष करके यह कि तुम भविष्यद्वाणी करो।
hi.B: प्रेम को पाने का यत्न करो, और आत्मिक वरदानों को पाने की लालसा रखो, सबसे बढ़कर भविष्यद्वाणी करने की।
hi.R: सबसे बढ़कर, दूसरों से प्रेम करने में पूरा मन लगाओ। और उन वरदानों को पाने की पूरी कोशिश करो जो पवित्र आत्मा देता है, सबसे ज़्यादा भविष्यद्वाणी के वरदान को, यानी परमेश्वर की ओर से संदेश सुनाने को।

ru.L: Стремитесь к любви, ревнуйте же о духовных [дарах], а больше всего — чтобы вам пророчествовать.
ru.B: Стремитесь к любви и всем сердцем желайте духовных даров, а больше всего — пророчествовать.
ru.R: Прежде всего старайтесь любить других. И старайтесь получить дары, которые даёт Дух, а больше всего — дар пророчества, то есть способность передавать слова от Бога.

uk.L: Женіться за любовʼю, ревнуйте ж про духовні [дари], а найбільше, щоб ви пророкували.
uk.B: Прагніть любові і всім серцем бажайте духовних дарів, а найбільше пророкування.
uk.R: Понад усе старайтеся любити інших. І щиро прагніть отримати дари, які дає Дух, найбільше дар пророцтва, щоб передавати вістки від Бога.

ja.L: 愛を追い求めなさい。また、霊的な[賜物]を熱心に求めなさい。しかし、特に預言することを[求めなさい]。
ja.B: 愛を追い求めなさい。そして、霊の賜物を熱心に求めなさい。中でも、預言することを求めなさい。
ja.R: 何よりも、人を愛することに力を注いでください。そして、聖霊がくださる贈り物をいただけるように、熱心に求めてください。中でも、預言する贈り物、つまり神から与えられた言葉を語る贈り物を求めてください。

decisions.choice: pursue love: make love the goal, and go after it with effort
decisions.reason: Διώκετε is the verb for running after something, pursuing it (Romans 14:19; Philippians 3:12, 14). It joins chapter 13 to chapter 14: love is the aim, and the gifts are to be sought within it.

decisions.choice: the spiritual things: the gifts the Spirit gives
decisions.reason: τὰ πνευματικά is the neuter plural of the adjective used in 12:1. Here it is what the Corinthians are to be zealous for, as the greater gifts are in 12:31, so the gifts are meant.

decisions.choice: especially that you may prophesy: of all the gifts, prophecy is the one to seek most
alternatives: instead of seeking the gifts, seek to prophesy
decisions.reason: μᾶλλον δὲ marks what is preferred. Paul is not setting prophecy against the other gifts, which he has just told them to seek, but ranking it first; verses 2-5 give the reason.

decisions.choice: be zealous for: seek eagerly, set one's heart on
decisions.reason: As in 12:31, where the same verb ζηλοῦτε is used for the greater gifts; it returns in 14:39. It is a good eagerness here, not rivalry.

decisions.choice: set your hearts on (B); try hard to receive (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 12:31 and 14:39, so that readers can see Paul take up the command again.

decisions.choice: the spiritual [gifts] (L); spiritual gifts (B); the gifts that the Spirit gives (R)
decisions.reason: As in 12:1, the levels supply 'gifts' (m2).

decisions.choice: speaking messages from God
decisions.reason: Readable explains what prophecy is, as at 11:4, since many readers think only of predicting the future.

decisions.choice: aspirez à (L); désirez vivement (B); cherchez de tout votre cœur à (R), the same words in 14:39
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek eagerly and set one's heart on something (m4). "Soyez zélés" is stiff in modern French; the same French returns in 14:39, where Paul takes up the command again, as the English keeps its words.

decisions.choice: procurar con celo (L); anhelar (B); procurar recibir (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek eagerly (m4). Literal keeps the picture of zeal with "con celo"; Balanced says "anhelar", which Spanish uses for setting one's heart on something; Readable says "procurar recibir", as the English "try hard to receive". The same words come back in verse 39.

decisions.choice: profetizar, profecía; hablar en lenguas, una lengua (chapter 14)
decisions.reason: The gifts keep the names of 12:10 and the existing Spanish of Acts 2:4, 10:46 and 19:6: "profetizar" and "profecía", "hablar en lenguas" (singular "en una lengua" where the Greek is singular), "interpretar". "Idiomas" would decide that the tongues are human languages, which the meaning decisions leave open; "predicar" is a different activity.

decisions.choice: kutabiri, unabii, nabii
decisions.reason: The verb, noun and person-noun Swahili Acts 2:17-18 and Romans 12:6 use: "kutabiri" (prophesy), "unabii" (prophecy), "nabii" (prophet), kept through chapter 14. Since "kutabiri" can also suggest foretelling, Readable says once what it means here, speaking a message from God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "khao khát" (L), "hết lòng ước ao" (B), "cố gắng để nhận được" (R) for zeloo, as in 12:31 (also 14:12, 14:39)
decisions.reason: The same verb is kept wherever Paul urges them to seek the gifts; "ganh tị" is the word for the bad zeal of 3:3 and 13:4.

decisions.choice: "영적인 [은사들]" (L), "영적인 은사" (B), "성령께서 주시는 은사" (R), as in 12:1; "열심히 구하다" (L), "간절히 사모하다" (B), "받으려고 힘쓰다" (R), as in 12:31; "예언" at every level, through the chapter
decisions.reason: The same words as 12:1 and 12:31, so the chapters read as one argument.

decisions.choice: Busquem
decisions.reason: The verb is "run after, pursue" (m1). Portuguese "perseguir" would suggest persecution, which the same Greek verb means elsewhere; "buscar" keeps the sense of going after a goal.

decisions.choice: "በቅናት ፈልጉ" (seek with zeal)
decisions.reason: "ቅናት" keeps the Greek word's zeal, as in 12:31 and 14:39; the bare verb "ቅኑ" would read as "be jealous". Balanced says "ልባችሁን ... ላይ አድርጉ" (set your hearts on), Readable "ጥረት አድርጉ" (try hard).

decisions.choice: "धुन में रहो" (L); "लालसा रखो" (B); "पूरी कोशिश करो" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 12:31 and 14:39 at each level, so the reader sees Paul take up the command again.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वाणी करना"; Readable adds "परमेश्वर की ओर से संदेश सुनाना"
decisions.reason: As at 11:4: to prophesy is to speak a message from God, not only to foretell. Readable names the gift and says what it is once here; later in the chapter it uses either.

decisions.choice: всем сердцем желайте (B); старайтесь получить (R); ревнуйте (L)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 12:31 and 14:39 at each level, so that readers can see Paul take up the command again. "Ревновать о" is kept at Literal; in current Russian it usually means jealousy.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ ἀλλὰ θεῷ, οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἀκούει, πνεύματι δὲ λαλεῖ μυστήρια·

records.literal_gloss: The [one] for speaking in a tongue not to people speaks but to God; no one for hears, in spirit but he speaks mysteries;

en.L: For the one speaking in a tongue speaks not to people but to God, for no one understands; but in [the] Spirit [the speaker] utters mysteries.
en.B: Someone who speaks in a tongue is speaking not to people but to God. No one understands what is said; in the Spirit, the speaker is uttering mysteries.
en.R: When people speak in tongues, they are not speaking to other people. They are speaking to God. No one else can understand them. The Spirit is helping them speak, but what they say is a mystery to everyone else.

fr.L: Car celui qui parle en langue ne parle pas {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}} mais à Dieu, car personne ne comprend ; mais dans l’Esprit [celui qui parle] dit des mystères.
fr.B: Celui qui parle en langue ne s’adresse pas {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}}, mais à Dieu. Personne ne comprend ce qu’il dit : dans l’Esprit, il prononce des mystères.
fr.R: Quand quelqu’un parle en langues, il ne parle pas aux autres. Il parle à Dieu. Personne d’autre ne peut le comprendre. L’Esprit l’aide à parler, mais ce qu’il dit reste un mystère pour tous les autres.

es.L: Porque el que habla en una lengua no habla a [los] hombres sino a Dios, pues nadie [lo] entiende; pero en [el] Espíritu dice misterios.
es.B: El que habla en una lengua no habla a la gente sino a Dios. Nadie entiende lo que dice; en el Espíritu está diciendo misterios.
es.R: Cuando alguien habla en lenguas, no habla a otras personas. Habla a Dios. Nadie más puede entenderlo. El Espíritu le ayuda a hablar, pero lo que dice es un misterio para todos los demás.

sw.L: Kwa maana anayenena kwa lugha haneni na watu bali na Mungu, kwa maana hakuna mtu anayeelewa; lakini katika Roho [yeye] anatamka siri.
sw.B: Mtu anayenena kwa lugha hasemi na watu bali na Mungu. Hakuna mtu anayeelewa anachosema; katika Roho, msemaji anatamka siri.
sw.R: Watu wanaonena kwa lugha hawasemi na watu wengine. Wanasema na Mungu. Hakuna mtu mwingine anayeweza kuwaelewa. Roho anawasaidia kusema, lakini wanachosema ni siri kwa wengine wote.

vi.L: Vì người nói tiếng lạ không nói với người ta nhưng với Đức Chúa Trời, vì không ai hiểu; nhưng trong Thánh Linh [người ấy] nói ra những điều mầu nhiệm.
vi.B: Người nói tiếng lạ không nói với người ta mà nói với Đức Chúa Trời. Không ai hiểu điều người ấy nói; trong Thánh Linh, người ấy đang nói ra những điều mầu nhiệm.
vi.R: Khi người ta nói tiếng lạ, họ không nói với người khác. Họ nói với Đức Chúa Trời. Không ai khác hiểu được họ. Thánh Linh giúp họ nói, nhưng điều họ nói là một điều bí ẩn đối với mọi người khác.

ko.L: 방언으로 말하는 사람은 사람들에게 말하지 않고 하나님께 말합니다. 아무도 알아듣지 못하기 때문입니다. 그는 영으로 비밀들을 말합니다.
ko.B: 방언으로 말하는 사람은 사람들에게가 아니라 하나님께 말하는 것입니다. 아무도 그 말을 알아듣지 못합니다. 그는 성령 안에서 비밀을 말하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 사람들이 방언으로 말할 때, 그들은 다른 사람들에게 말하는 것이 아닙니다. 하나님께 말하는 것입니다. 다른 사람은 아무도 그 말을 알아듣지 못합니다. 성령께서 그들이 말하도록 도우시지만, 그들이 하는 말은 다른 모든 사람에게 비밀입니다.

pt.L: Pois quem fala em língua não fala a pessoas, mas a Deus, pois ninguém entende; mas no Espírito [quem fala] diz mistérios.
pt.B: Quem fala em língua não está falando às pessoas, mas a Deus. Ninguém entende o que é dito; no Espírito, a pessoa está falando mistérios.
pt.R: Quando alguém fala em línguas, não está falando com as outras pessoas. Está falando com Deus. Ninguém mais consegue entender. O Espírito está ajudando essa pessoa a falar, mas o que ela diz é um mistério para todos os outros.

am.L: በልሳን የሚናገር ለሰዎች ሳይሆን ለእግዚአብሔር ይናገራልና፤ ማንም አያስተውለውምና፤ በመንፈስ ግን [ተናጋሪው] ምሥጢራትን ይናገራል።
am.B: በልሳን የሚናገር ሰው የሚናገረው ለሰዎች ሳይሆን ለእግዚአብሔር ነው። የሚለውን ማንም አያስተውልም፤ በመንፈስ ምሥጢራትን ይናገራል።
am.R: ሰዎች በልዩ ቋንቋ ሲናገሩ የሚናገሩት ለሌሎች ሰዎች አይደለም። የሚናገሩት ለእግዚአብሔር ነው። ሌላ ማንም ሊረዳቸው አይችልም። መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዲናገሩ ይረዳቸዋል፤ የሚሉት ግን ለሌሎች ሁሉ ምሥጢር ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि जो भाषा में बोलता है, वह मनुष्यों से नहीं पर परमेश्वर से बोलता है, क्योंकि कोई नहीं समझता; पर वह आत्मा में भेद की बातें बोलता है।
hi.B: जो अन्य भाषा में बोलता है, वह मनुष्यों से नहीं, परमेश्वर से बोल रहा है। कोई उसकी बात नहीं समझता; वह आत्मा में भेद की बातें बोल रहा है।
hi.R: जब लोग दूसरी भाषाओं में बोलते हैं, तो वे दूसरे लोगों से नहीं बोल रहे होते। वे परमेश्वर से बोल रहे होते हैं। कोई और उनकी बात नहीं समझ पाता। पवित्र आत्मा उन्हें बोलने में सहायता देता है, पर वे जो कहते हैं, वह बाक़ी सब के लिए भेद ही रहता है।

ru.L: Ведь говорящий на языке говорит не людям, а Богу, ведь никто не понимает, духом же он говорит тайны;
ru.B: Тот, кто говорит на языке, говорит не людям, а Богу. Никто не понимает, что он говорит: в духе он произносит тайны.
ru.R: Когда люди говорят на языках, они говорят не другим людям, а Богу. Никто другой не может их понять. Дух помогает им говорить, но то, что они говорят, остаётся тайной для всех остальных.

uk.L: Бо хто говорить мовою, говорить не людям, а Богові, бо ніхто не розуміє; а духом [він] говорить таємниці.
uk.B: Хто говорить мовою, той говорить не людям, а Богові. Ніхто не розуміє сказаного; у Дусі мовець говорить таємниці.
uk.R: Коли люди говорять мовами, вони говорять не до інших людей. Вони говорять до Бога. Ніхто інший не може їх зрозуміти. Дух допомагає їм говорити, але те, що вони кажуть, для всіх інших — таємниця.

ja.L: というのは、異言で語る者は、人々に語るのではなく、神に語るのです。だれも聞き取れないからです。しかし、[その人は]霊によって奥義を語っているのです。
ja.B: 異言で語る人は、人に向かってではなく、神に向かって語っています。だれもその言葉を理解できません。その人は、霊によって奥義を語っているのです。
ja.R: 異言で話す人は、ほかの人に話しているのではありません。神に話しているのです。ほかの人には、だれにも分かりません。聖霊が助けて話させてくださっていますが、その人が話していることは、ほかの人にとっては秘密のままなのです。

decisions.choice: speaks to God: a tongue is addressed to God, in prayer or praise
alternatives: a tongue is a message from God to people
decisions.reason: Verses 14-17 speak of praying, singing and giving thanks in a tongue: the speech goes up to God. That is why it does not build up others unless it is interpreted (verse 5).

decisions.choice: hears: understands
decisions.reason: Those present hear the sound; ἀκούει means that no one grasps what is said, as the same verb is used in the Greek Old Testament of Genesis 11:7, where the builders of Babel can no longer understand one another's speech.

decisions.choice: in the Spirit: the Holy Spirit gives the speech
alternatives: in his spirit: with the speaker's own spirit rather than the mind (verse 14)
decisions.reason: πνεύματι has neither an article nor 'my', so it could mean either. The Spirit is the one who gives tongues (12:10-11), which favors the Holy Spirit. Verse 14 ('my spirit prays') speaks of the speaker's own spirit, which favors the other reading. The two are close: in a tongue the speaker's spirit is moved by God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: mysteries: things hidden from the hearers, because no one understands them
alternatives: God's plan, once hidden and now made known, as in 2:7 and 15:51
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in Paul μυστήρια usually names God's purpose now revealed. Here the point is that the words stay hidden from those who hear them.

decisions.choice: mysteries (L, B); a mystery to everyone else (R)
decisions.reason: The key term 'mystery' is kept at every level, with its sense here given in m4. Readable says to whom it is a mystery.

decisions.choice: in [the] Spirit [the speaker] utters
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the article and a subject, which the Greek verb leaves unexpressed.

decisions.choice: The Spirit is helping them speak
decisions.reason: Readable says what 'in the Spirit' means, following m3. Since m3 is uncertain, this is marked for reviewers.

decisions.choice: {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}} (L, B); aux autres (R); the same in 14:3
decisions.reason: The English "people" needs no span, but French has to choose a noun for the Greek word for human beings, men and women. The inclusive default says it plainly, with the traditional "aux hommes" as the alternative; Readable says "aux autres", which needs neither.

decisions.choice: [los] hombres, no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek word means human beings in general; Literal "[los] hombres" is the plain Spanish generic set against "Dios", and Balanced and Readable say "la gente", "otras personas". The English has no gender span here.

decisions.choice: kunena kwa lugha
decisions.reason: "Kunena kwa lugha" is the usual Swahili name for this gift and the phrase Swahili Acts 10:46 uses. "Lugha" has one form for singular and plural, so it serves both "a tongue" and "tongues" all through the chapter; "ndimi" (tongues, the Literal choice in Acts 2:4) has the awkward singular "ulimi", which verse 9 keeps for the tongue in the mouth. Like the English "tongues", "lugha" leaves open whether human languages are meant (footnoted in the meaning decisions). To be harmonised with chapters 12-13.

decisions.choice: siri
decisions.reason: "Siri" as in 2:7 and 4:1, here things hidden from the hearers because no one understands them (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "trong Thánh Linh", capitalised; "những điều mầu nhiệm" (L, B), "một điều bí ẩn" (R)
decisions.reason: The reading of m3, that the Holy Spirit gives the speech, as the English capitalises it; the other reading, the speaker's own spirit, is given in m3. The mysteries here are only things the hearers do not understand (m4).

decisions.choice: "영으로" (L); "성령 안에서" (B); "성령께서 ... 도우시지만" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as the Holy Spirit who gives the speech, uncertain and footnoted; Literal keeps the bare "영" of the Greek, which has no article.
The names of the gift from 12:10, kept through the chapter. "भेद" for mysteries, as in 13:2.

decisions.choice: тайны (L, B); тайной для всех остальных (R)
decisions.reason: The key term "тайна" is kept at every level, with its sense here given in meaning decision m4; Readable says to whom it is hidden. "Дух" and "духом" are lowercase in Literal and Balanced to leave open, with the Greek, whether the human spirit is meant.

decisions.choice: говорити мовою, мовами (as in 12:10)
decisions.reason: The gift keeps the name fixed in 12:8-10; "мова" in the singular for one utterance, as the Greek has the singular here.

decisions.choice: "霊によって" (L, B); "聖霊が助けて話させてくださって" (R)
decisions.reason: Read as the Holy Spirit giving the speech (m3, uncertain, footnoted in the English).

source.text: ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ οἰκοδομὴν καὶ παράκλησιν καὶ παραμυθίαν.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] but prophesying to people speaks building up and encouragement and comfort.

en.L: But the one prophesying speaks to people [for] building up and encouragement and comfort.
en.B: But someone who prophesies speaks to people, and the words build them up, encourage them and comfort them.
en.R: But people who prophesy speak to others. What they say helps others grow stronger, gives them courage, and comforts them.

fr.L: Mais celui qui prophétise parle {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}} [pour l’]édification, l’encouragement et le réconfort.
fr.B: Mais celui qui prophétise parle {{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}}, et ses paroles les édifient, les encouragent et les réconfortent.
fr.R: Mais quand quelqu’un prophétise, il parle aux autres. Ce qu’il dit les aide à devenir plus forts, leur donne du courage et les console.

es.L: Pero el que profetiza habla a [los] hombres [para] edificación, exhortación y consuelo.
es.B: Pero el que profetiza habla a la gente, y sus palabras la edifican, la animan y la consuelan.
es.R: Pero quien profetiza habla a los demás. Lo que dice ayuda a los otros a fortalecerse, les da ánimo y los consuela.

sw.L: Lakini anayetabiri anasema na watu [kwa] kujenga na kutia moyo na kufariji.
sw.B: Lakini mtu anayetabiri anasema na watu, na maneno yake huwajenga, huwatia moyo na kuwafariji.
sw.R: Lakini watu wanaotabiri wanasema na wengine. Maneno yao huwaimarisha wengine, huwapa moyo, na kuwafariji.

vi.L: Nhưng người nói tiên tri thì nói với người ta [để] gây dựng, khích lệ và an ủi.
vi.B: Còn người nói tiên tri thì nói với người ta, và lời của người ấy gây dựng, khích lệ và an ủi họ.
vi.R: Nhưng những người nói tiên tri thì nói với người khác. Những gì họ nói giúp người khác vững mạnh hơn, cho họ thêm can đảm, và an ủi họ.

ko.L: 그러나 예언하는 사람은 사람들에게 세움과 권면과 위로를 말합니다.
ko.B: 그러나 예언하는 사람은 사람들에게 말하며, 그 말은 그들을 세워 주고 권면하고 위로합니다.
ko.R: 그러나 예언하는 사람들은 다른 사람들에게 말합니다. 그들이 하는 말은 다른 사람들을 더 굳세게 하고, 용기를 주고, 위로해 줍니다.

pt.L: Mas quem profetiza fala às pessoas [para] edificação, encorajamento e consolo.
pt.B: Mas quem profetiza fala às pessoas, e as suas palavras as edificam, as encorajam e as consolam.
pt.R: Mas quem profetiza fala com os outros. O que essa pessoa diz ajuda os outros a ficar mais fortes, dá coragem a eles e os consola.

am.L: ትንቢት የሚናገር ግን ለሰዎች ማነጽን፣ ማበረታታትንና ማጽናናትን ይናገራል።
am.B: ትንቢት የሚናገር ግን ለሰዎች ይናገራል፤ ቃሉም ያንጻቸዋል፣ ያበረታታቸዋል፣ ያጽናናቸዋልም።
am.R: ትንቢት የሚናገሩ ሰዎች ግን የሚናገሩት ለሌሎች ነው። የሚሉት ሌሎች እንዲጠነክሩ ይረዳል፤ ብርታት ይሰጣቸዋል፤ ያጽናናቸዋልም።

hi.L: पर जो भविष्यद्वाणी करता है, वह मनुष्यों से उन्नति और प्रोत्साहन और सांत्वना की [बातें] कहता है।
hi.B: पर जो भविष्यद्वाणी करता है, वह मनुष्यों से बोलता है, और उसकी बातें उनकी उन्नति करती हैं, उन्हें प्रोत्साहन देती हैं और सांत्वना देती हैं।
hi.R: पर जो लोग भविष्यद्वाणी करते हैं, वे दूसरों से बोलते हैं। उनकी बातें दूसरों को मज़बूत बनाती हैं, उनका हौसला बढ़ाती हैं, और उन्हें तसल्ली देती हैं।

ru.L: А пророчествующий говорит людям [для] созидания, и ободрения, и утешения.
ru.B: А тот, кто пророчествует, говорит людям, и его слова укрепляют их, ободряют и утешают.
ru.R: А люди, которые пророчествуют, говорят другим. Их слова помогают другим становиться сильнее, дают им смелость и утешают их.

uk.L: А хто пророкує, говорить людям [на] збудування, і заохочення, і розраду.
uk.B: А хто пророкує, той говорить людям, і його слова будують їх, підбадьорюють і втішають.
uk.R: Але люди, які пророкують, говорять до інших. Те, що вони кажуть, допомагає іншим зміцніти, додає їм відваги і втішає їх.

ja.L: しかし、預言する者は、人々に向かって、建て上げと励ましと慰めを語ります。
ja.B: しかし、預言する人は人々に向かって語り、その言葉は人々を造り上げ、励まし、慰めます。
ja.R: でも、預言する人は、ほかの人たちに向かって話します。その言葉は、人々を強くし、勇気づけ、慰めます。

decisions.choice: building up: making the church grow strong, like a building rising on its foundation
decisions.reason: οἰκοδομὴν is the act of building. Paul pictures the church as God's building (3:9-10) and speaks of love building up (8:1; 10:23). The word runs through this chapter (verses 3-5, 12, 17, 26) as the test of every gift.

decisions.choice: encouragement and comfort: urging on, and consoling those who are downcast
decisions.reason: παράκλησιν can mean comfort, appeal or encouragement, and it is the word for comfort in 2 Corinthians 1:3-7. Here it stands beside παραμυθίαν, consolation for those who grieve or lose heart (as in Philippians 2:1), so it has its other sense, encouragement.

decisions.choice: to people: unlike a tongue, prophecy is understood by those who hear it
decisions.reason: The contrast with verse 2 is exact: the one speaks to God, the other to people.

decisions.choice: building up (L); build them up (B); helps others grow stronger (R)
decisions.reason: 'Build up' keeps Paul's picture of a building, as in 8:1, 10:23 and 2 Corinthians 10:8; 'edification' is now church language. Readable says 'grow stronger' throughout the chapter, as 8:1 says 'makes others strong'.

decisions.choice: [for] building up
decisions.reason: The Greek makes the three nouns the object of 'speaks'; Literal supplies 'for' to show that they name what the speech does.

decisions.choice: l’édification, édifier (L, B); aider à devenir plus fort (R), throughout the chapter
decisions.reason: "Édifier" is built on "édifice" and so keeps Paul's picture of a building going up, which the English "build up" keeps; "construire" said of people sounds odd in French. Readable says plainly what is meant, as the English "grow stronger" does.

decisions.choice: edificación, edificar (L, B); fortalecerse, fortalecer (R) (chapter 14)
decisions.reason: "Edificar" is the Spanish word for building up a person or a church, kept at Literal and Balanced as in 8:1 and 8:10; Readable says "fortalecer", as it does in 8:1, for the English "grow stronger".

decisions.choice: exhortación
decisions.reason: The word means urging on and encouraging (m2). Literal keeps "exhortación" beside "consuelo" so the two Greek words stay two Spanish nouns; Balanced and Readable turn them into the verbs "animar" and "consolar".

decisions.choice: kujenga (L, B); kuimarisha (R)
decisions.reason: The verb "kujenga" (build up) settled in 8:1 and 10:23 for this word family, kept through chapter 14 so the building picture of the meaning decision stays visible; Readable says "kuimarisha" (make strong), as in 10:23.

decisions.choice: "gây dựng" (L, B), "giúp ... vững mạnh" (R) for oikodome through chapter 14; "khích lệ" and "an ủi" for paraklesis and paramythia
decisions.reason: As in 8:1. In 2 Corinthians, where paraklesis is the main word for comfort, "an ủi" is kept for it; here two Greek words stand side by side, so Vietnamese gives them two words.

decisions.choice: "세움" (L), "세워 주다" (B), "굳세게 하다" (R) for building up, through the chapter; "권면" for encouragement; "위로" for comfort
decisions.reason: "세워 주다" is the word of 8:1 and 10:23 for building up; "덕을 세우다" is the older church phrase. "위로" is the word for comfort through 2 Corinthians 1.

decisions.choice: edificação, edificar (L, B); ajudar a ficar mais forte (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter. Portuguese "edificar" is the ordinary verb for constructing a building ("edifício"), so it keeps Paul's picture (m1) and is understood by Brazilian readers, although it is also church language. Readable says "ficar mais forte", as the English Readable says "grow stronger".

decisions.choice: "ማነጽ" (to build up)
decisions.reason: "ማነጽ" is to build and is used in Amharic for building up a person or a church, so the picture of a building rising (m1) stays at Literal and Balanced through the chapter. Readable says "እንዲጠነክሩ መርዳት" (help to grow strong), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "उन्नति" (L, B), "मज़बूत बनाना" (R); "सांत्वना" (L, B), "तसल्ली" (R)
decisions.reason: The building word keeps the choices of 8:1 through the chapter. Comfort is consoling the downcast (meaning decision m2); "शान्ति" is kept for peace, the key term, so comfort is "सांत्वना".

decisions.choice: созидание (L); укрепляют (B); помогают становиться сильнее (R)
decisions.reason: The Synodal "назидание" now means moralising. Literal keeps the building picture with "созидание", as in 8:1 and 10:23; Balanced and Readable say what it does, as in those verses.

decisions.choice: збудування (L); будувати (B); допомагати зміцніти (R), for oikodomē, oikodomeō through chapter 14
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note keeps the building picture of 3:9-10 and 8:1. "Повчання" would turn building up into teaching.

decisions.choice: "建て上げ" (L); "造り上げ" (B); "強くする" (R), through chapter 14
decisions.reason: Making the church grow strong like a rising building (m1); the same words as for oikodomeō in 8:1.

source.text: ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ ἑαυτὸν οἰκοδομεῖ· ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἐκκλησίαν οἰκοδομεῖ.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] speaking in a tongue himself builds up; the [one] but prophesying [the] church builds up.

en.L: The one speaking in a tongue builds up {{gender:themselves|himself}}, but the one prophesying builds up [the] church.
en.B: Those who speak in a tongue build up themselves, but those who prophesy build up the church.
en.R: People who speak in tongues help only themselves grow stronger. But people who prophesy help the whole church grow stronger.

fr.L: Celui qui parle en langue s’édifie lui-même, mais celui qui prophétise édifie l’église.
fr.B: Ceux qui parlent en langue s’édifient eux-mêmes, mais ceux qui prophétisent édifient l’église.
fr.R: Quand quelqu’un parle en langues, il est le seul à devenir plus fort. Mais quand quelqu’un prophétise, il aide toute l’église à devenir plus forte.

es.L: El que habla en una lengua se edifica a sí mismo, pero el que profetiza edifica [a la] iglesia.
es.B: Los que hablan en una lengua se edifican a sí mismos, pero los que profetizan edifican a la iglesia.
es.R: Las personas que hablan en lenguas solo se fortalecen a sí mismas. Pero las que profetizan ayudan a toda la iglesia a fortalecerse.

sw.L: Anayenena kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe; lakini anayetabiri hulijenga kanisa.
sw.B: Anayenena kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe, lakini anayetabiri hulijenga kanisa.
sw.R: Watu wanaonena kwa lugha hujiimarisha wao wenyewe tu. Lakini watu wanaotabiri huliimarisha kanisa zima.

vi.L: Người nói tiếng lạ thì gây dựng chính mình, nhưng người nói tiên tri thì gây dựng Hội Thánh.
vi.B: Người nói tiếng lạ gây dựng chính mình, còn người nói tiên tri gây dựng Hội Thánh.
vi.R: Những người nói tiếng lạ chỉ giúp chính mình vững mạnh hơn. Nhưng những người nói tiên tri giúp cả Hội Thánh vững mạnh hơn.

ko.L: 방언으로 말하는 사람은 자기 자신을 세우지만, 예언하는 사람은 교회를 세웁니다.
ko.B: 방언으로 말하는 사람은 자기 자신을 세우지만, 예언하는 사람은 교회를 세웁니다.
ko.R: 방언으로 말하는 사람들은 자기 자신만 굳세게 합니다. 그러나 예언하는 사람들은 교회 전체를 굳세게 합니다.

pt.L: Quem fala em língua edifica a si mesmo, mas quem profetiza edifica [a] igreja.
pt.B: Quem fala em língua edifica a si mesmo, mas quem profetiza edifica a igreja.
pt.R: Quem fala em línguas ajuda só a si mesmo a ficar mais forte. Mas quem profetiza ajuda a igreja toda a ficar mais forte.

am.L: በልሳን የሚናገር ራሱን ያንጻል፤ ትንቢት የሚናገር ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ያንጻል።
am.B: በልሳን የሚናገሩ ራሳቸውን ያንጻሉ፤ ትንቢት የሚናገሩ ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ያንጻሉ።
am.R: በልዩ ቋንቋዎች የሚናገሩ ሰዎች ራሳቸውን ብቻ እንዲጠነክሩ ይረዳሉ። ትንቢት የሚናገሩ ግን መላዋ ቤተ ክርስቲያን እንድትጠነክር ይረዳሉ።

hi.L: जो भाषा में बोलता है, वह अपनी ही उन्नति करता है, पर जो भविष्यद्वाणी करता है, वह कलीसिया की उन्नति करता है।
hi.B: जो अन्य भाषा में बोलते हैं, वे अपनी ही उन्नति करते हैं, पर जो भविष्यद्वाणी करते हैं, वे कलीसिया की उन्नति करते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग दूसरी भाषाओं में बोलते हैं, वे केवल अपने आप को मज़बूत बनाते हैं। पर जो लोग भविष्यद्वाणी करते हैं, वे सारी कलीसिया को मज़बूत बनाते हैं।

ru.L: Говорящий на языке созидает себя, а пророчествующий созидает церковь.
ru.B: Те, кто говорит на языке, укрепляют самих себя, а те, кто пророчествует, укрепляют церковь.
ru.R: Люди, которые говорят на языках, помогают стать сильнее только себе. А люди, которые пророчествуют, помогают стать сильнее всей церкви.

uk.L: Хто говорить мовою, будує себе; а хто пророкує, будує церкву.
uk.B: Ті, хто говорить мовою, будують самих себе, а ті, хто пророкує, будують церкву.
uk.R: Люди, які говорять мовами, допомагають зміцніти лише собі. А люди, які пророкують, допомагають зміцніти всій церкві.

ja.L: 異言で語る者は自分自身を建て上げ、預言する者は教会を建て上げます。
ja.B: 異言で語る人は自分自身を造り上げますが、預言する人は教会を造り上げます。
ja.R: 異言で話す人は、自分だけを強くします。でも、預言する人は、教会全体を強くするのです。

decisions.choice: builds up himself: a real benefit, but for the speaker alone
alternatives: a rebuke of a self-centered use of the gift
decisions.reason: Paul does not say that being built up oneself is wrong: he goes on to wish that all spoke in tongues (verse 5) and thanks God for his own gift (verse 18). But the gifts are given for the good of all (12:7), so in the gathering a gift that helps only its user is the lesser.

decisions.choice: church: the believers as they gather together
decisions.reason: ἐκκλησίαν has no article: the assembly of believers when they meet. Throughout the chapter Paul has the gathering in view (verses 19, 23, 28).

decisions.choice: Those who speak ... those who prophesy (B); People who ... (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plurals, since men and women alike are meant; Literal keeps the singular with the gender setting.

decisions.choice: only themselves; the whole church
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the contrast between one person and everyone (m1).

decisions.choice: "celui qui ... lui-même" with no gender span, and the same for the generic "il", "lui", "son" throughout the chapter
decisions.reason: The English needs {{gender:themselves|himself}}, but in French "celui qui" and "quelqu’un" already mean anyone, man or woman, and the pronouns that refer back to them are ordinary generic French (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: l’église, lowercase, throughout the chapter
decisions.reason: Here the church is the believers as they gather (m2), one congregation, so French writes it without the capital kept for the whole body of believers.

decisions.choice: se edifica a sí mismo, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English gender span ({{gender:themselves|himself}}) has nothing to change in Spanish: "el que" and "a sí mismo" are the ordinary generic forms for anyone, man or woman, as in 3:18. The same holds for the other generic "he" and "himself" in this chapter (verses 13, 28, 37-38).

decisions.choice: hujijenga mwenyewe: no gender span
decisions.reason: The reflexive "-ji-" and "mwenyewe" do not mark sex, nor do the verb prefix a- and "yake", so the English gender spans in this chapter (verses 4, 13, 24-25, 28, 37-38) have nothing to switch in Swahili.

decisions.choice: quem ... a si mesmo, with no gender setting (here and in verses 13, 24-25, 28, 37-38)
alternatives: {{gender:a si mesmo ou a si mesma|a si mesmo}}
decisions.reason: Portuguese "quem", "alguém" and "algum descrente" already mean anyone, man or woman, and the "ele" or "a si mesmo" that refers back to them is ordinary generic Portuguese (style guide §7), so these sentences need no gender setting where the English has one. Readable often says "essa pessoa ... ela", which is plainly inclusive.

decisions.choice: no gender spans: "ራሱን", "ይጸልይ", "ዝም ይበል" and the like
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The generic masculine in Amharic (the suffix -ኡ and the third-person verb) already includes women, so Amharic has only one way of saying these and the English gender spans in verses 4, 13, 24-25, 28, 37 and 38 have nothing to change. The address to the believers keeps its span.

decisions.choice: "अपनी ही", no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for "themselves / himself"; the Hindi reflexive and the generic "जो ... वह" have no gender, so there is nothing to change (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: себя (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has gender spans on the pronouns for the one who speaks in a tongue, here and in verses 13, 24-25, 28 and 37-38. Russian uses the reflexive "себя" or a masculine form after "тот, кто" / "кто-то", which already covers men and women, so Russian has no gender span in this chapter.

decisions.choice: себе, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Ukrainian reflexive "себе" has no gender, so the English span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "自分自身" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English themselves/himself
decisions.reason: Japanese "自分自身" is already inclusive, so the English pronoun span is not needed (style 7a).

source.text: θέλω δὲ πάντας ὑμᾶς λαλεῖν γλώσσαις, μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε· μείζων δὲ ὁ προφητεύων ἢ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσαις, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ διερμηνεύῃ, ἵνα ἡ ἐκκλησία οἰκοδομὴν λάβῃ.

records.literal_gloss: I want now all you to speak in tongues, rather but that you may prophesy; greater and the [one] prophesying than the [one] speaking in tongues, except if not he interprets, so that the church building up may receive.

en.L: Now I want all of you to speak in tongues, but rather that you may prophesy; and the one prophesying [is] greater than the one speaking in tongues, unless [the speaker] interprets, so that the church may receive building up.
en.B: I would be glad for all of you to speak in tongues, but gladder still for you to prophesy. Those who prophesy are greater than those who speak in tongues, unless they also interpret, so that the church receives something that builds it up.
en.R: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would much rather have you prophesy. Prophesying is more important than speaking in tongues, unless the speakers also interpret what they say. Then the whole church can grow stronger.

fr.L: Or je veux que vous parliez tous en langues, mais plutôt que vous prophétisiez ; et celui qui prophétise [est] plus grand que celui qui parle en langues, à moins que [celui qui parle] n’interprète, afin que l’église reçoive de l’édification.
fr.B: Je serais heureux que vous parliez tous en langues, mais plus heureux encore que vous prophétisiez. Celui qui prophétise est plus grand que celui qui parle en langues, à moins que celui-ci n’interprète aussi, pour que l’église en reçoive quelque chose qui l’édifie.
fr.R: J’aimerais que chacun de vous parle en langues, mais je préférerais de beaucoup que vous prophétisiez. Prophétiser est plus important que parler en langues, sauf si celui qui parle en langues interprète aussi ce qu’il dit. Alors toute l’église peut devenir plus forte.

es.L: Ahora bien, quiero que todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:hablen|habléis}} en lenguas, pero más aún que {{plural_you:profeticen|profeticéis}}; y mayor [es] el que profetiza que el que habla en lenguas, a no ser que [este] interprete, para que la iglesia reciba edificación.
es.B: Me gustaría que todos {{plural_you:ustedes hablaran|vosotros hablarais}} en lenguas, pero más aún que {{plural_you:profetizaran|profetizarais}}. El que profetiza es mayor que el que habla en lenguas, a menos que también interprete, para que la iglesia reciba algo que la edifique.
es.R: Me gustaría que cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} hablara en lenguas, pero preferiría mucho más que {{plural_you:profetizaran|profetizarais}}. Profetizar es más importante que hablar en lenguas, a menos que quien habla interprete también lo que dice. Así toda la iglesia podrá fortalecerse.

sw.L: Basi nataka ninyi nyote mnene kwa lugha, lakini zaidi kwamba mtabiri; na anayetabiri ni mkuu kuliko anayenena kwa lugha, isipokuwa [yeye] afasiri, ili kanisa lipate kujengwa.
sw.B: Ningefurahi ninyi nyote mnene kwa lugha, lakini ningefurahi zaidi mtabiri. Anayetabiri ni mkuu kuliko anayenena kwa lugha, isipokuwa naye afasiri, ili kanisa lipate kitu cha kulijenga.
sw.R: Ningependa kila mmoja wenu anene kwa lugha, lakini zaidi sana ningependa mtabiri. Kutabiri ni muhimu kuliko kunena kwa lugha, isipokuwa wale wanaonena wafasiri pia wanachosema. Hapo kanisa zima litaimarika.

vi.L: Tôi muốn tất cả anh chị em đều nói tiếng lạ, nhưng tôi muốn anh chị em nói tiên tri hơn; người nói tiên tri thì lớn hơn người nói tiếng lạ, trừ khi [người ấy] thông giải, để Hội Thánh nhận được sự gây dựng.
vi.B: Tôi mong tất cả anh chị em đều nói tiếng lạ, nhưng tôi còn mong anh chị em nói tiên tri hơn nữa. Người nói tiên tri lớn hơn người nói tiếng lạ, trừ khi người ấy cũng thông giải, để Hội Thánh nhận được điều gây dựng.
vi.R: Tôi muốn mỗi người trong anh chị em đều nói tiếng lạ, nhưng tôi còn muốn anh chị em nói tiên tri hơn. Nói tiên tri quan trọng hơn nói tiếng lạ, trừ khi người nói tiếng lạ cũng thông giải những gì mình nói. Khi đó cả Hội Thánh có thể vững mạnh hơn.

ko.L: 나는 여러분이 모두 방언으로 말하기를 원하지만, 그보다 예언하기를 [원합니다]. 방언으로 말하는 사람이 통역하여 교회가 세움을 받게 하지 않는다면, 예언하는 사람이 방언으로 말하는 사람보다 더 큽니다.
ko.B: 나는 여러분이 모두 방언으로 말하기를 바라지만, 그보다 여러분이 예언하기를 더 바랍니다. 방언으로 말하는 사람이 통역도 해서 교회가 세움을 받게 하지 않는 한, 예언하는 사람이 방언으로 말하는 사람보다 더 큽니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분 모두가 방언으로 말하면 좋겠지만, 여러분이 예언하기를 훨씬 더 바랍니다. 예언하는 것이 방언으로 말하는 것보다 더 중요합니다. 다만 방언으로 말하는 사람이 자기가 한 말을 통역하면 다릅니다. 그러면 교회 전체가 굳세게 될 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Ora, quero que todos vocês falem em línguas, mas sobretudo que profetizem; e quem profetiza [é] maior do que quem fala em línguas, a não ser que [este] interprete, para que a igreja receba edificação.
pt.B: Eu ficaria contente se todos vocês falassem em línguas, mas ficaria ainda mais contente se profetizassem. Quem profetiza é maior do que quem fala em línguas, a não ser que também interprete, para que a igreja receba algo que a edifique.
pt.R: Eu gostaria que cada um de vocês falasse em línguas, mas gostaria muito mais que vocês profetizassem. Profetizar é mais importante do que falar em línguas, a não ser que a pessoa que fala também interprete o que diz. Assim a igreja toda pode ficar mais forte.

am.L: ሁላችሁም በልሳኖች እንድትናገሩ እወዳለሁ፤ ይልቁንም ትንቢት እንድትናገሩ [እወዳለሁ]፤ ትንቢት የሚናገርም በልሳኖች ከሚናገር ይበልጣል፤ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መታነጽን እንድትቀበል [ተናጋሪው] ካልተረጎመ በቀር።
am.B: ሁላችሁም በልሳኖች ብትናገሩ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ትንቢት ብትናገሩ ግን ከዚያ የበለጠ ደስ ይለኛል። ቤተ ክርስቲያን የሚያንጻትን ነገር እንድትቀበል በልሳኖች የሚናገሩት ደግሞ ካልተረጎሙ በቀር፣ ትንቢት የሚናገሩ በልሳኖች ከሚናገሩ ይበልጣሉ።
am.R: እያንዳንዳችሁ በልዩ ቋንቋዎች ብትናገሩ እወዳለሁ፤ ትንቢት ብትናገሩ ግን እጅግ እመርጣለሁ። ተናጋሪዎቹ የሚሉትን ካልተረጎሙ በቀር ትንቢት መናገር በልዩ ቋንቋዎች ከመናገር ይበልጣል። ቢተረጉሙ ግን መላዋ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ልትጠነክር ትችላለች።

hi.L: अब मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम सब भाषाओं में बोलो, पर इससे अधिक यह कि भविष्यद्वाणी करो; और जो भविष्यद्वाणी करता है, वह भाषाओं में बोलनेवाले से बड़ा है, जब तक कि [बोलनेवाला] अर्थ न बताए, ताकि कलीसिया की उन्नति हो।
hi.B: मुझे अच्छा लगेगा कि तुम सब अन्य भाषाओं में बोलो, पर इससे भी अच्छा यह कि तुम भविष्यद्वाणी करो। जो भविष्यद्वाणी करते हैं, वे अन्य भाषाओं में बोलनेवालों से बड़े हैं, जब तक कि वे अर्थ भी न बताएँ, ताकि कलीसिया को उन्नति मिले।
hi.R: मैं चाहूँगा कि तुममें से हर एक दूसरी भाषाओं में बोले, पर उससे कहीं ज़्यादा मैं यह चाहूँगा कि तुम भविष्यद्वाणी करो। भविष्यद्वाणी करना दूसरी भाषाओं में बोलने से ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है, जब तक कि बोलनेवाले अपनी कही बात का अर्थ भी न बताएँ। तब सारी कलीसिया मज़बूत हो सकती है।

ru.L: Хочу же, чтобы все вы говорили на языках, а больше — чтобы вы пророчествовали; больше же пророчествующий, чем говорящий на языках, разве только он [и] истолковывает, чтобы церковь получила созидание.
ru.B: Я был бы рад, если бы все вы говорили на языках, но ещё больше — если бы вы пророчествовали. Тот, кто пророчествует, больше того, кто говорит на языках, если только тот не истолковывает сказанное, чтобы церковь получила то, что её укрепляет.
ru.R: Я хотел бы, чтобы каждый из вас говорил на языках, но гораздо больше я хочу, чтобы вы пророчествовали. Пророчество важнее говорения на языках, если только говорящий не объясняет, что он сказал. Тогда вся церковь может становиться сильнее.

uk.L: Хочу ж, щоб ви всі говорили мовами, але радше щоб пророкували; бо більший той, хто пророкує, ніж той, хто говорить мовами, хіба що [він] тлумачить, щоб церква отримала збудування.
uk.B: Я був би радий, якби всі ви говорили мовами, але ще радіший, якби ви пророкували. Ті, хто пророкує, більші за тих, хто говорить мовами, хіба що вони також тлумачать, щоб церква отримала те, що її будує.
uk.R: Я хотів би, щоб кожен із вас говорив мовами, але набагато більше хотів би, щоб ви пророкували. Пророкувати важливіше, ніж говорити мовами, хіба що ті, хто говорить, також тлумачать сказане. Тоді вся церква може зміцніти.

ja.L: わたしは、あなたがた皆が異言で語ることを望みますが、それ以上に、あなたがたが預言することを[望みます]。預言する者は、異言で語る者よりもまさっています。ただし、[異言で語る者が]解き明かして、教会が建て上げられるのなら別です。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたがた皆が異言で語るなら喜びますが、預言するなら、なおいっそう喜びます。預言する人は、異言で語る人よりもまさっています。ただし、異言で語る人がそれを解き明かして、教会が造り上げられるのであれば、話は別です。
ja.R: わたしは、みなさん一人一人が異言で話せたらいいと思います。でも、それよりも、みなさんが預言してくれるほうが、ずっとうれしいのです。預言することは、異言で話すことよりも大切です。ただし、異言で話す人が、自分の話したことの意味を説明するなら別です。そうすれば、教会全体が強くされるからです。

decisions.choice: I want all of you to speak in tongues: a real wish, though prophecy is the greater one
alternatives: a concession: 'I grant that you may all speak in tongues'
decisions.reason: Paul values the gift (verses 18, 39) and does not forbid it. But μᾶλλον δὲ ('but rather') sets the greater wish beside the lesser one, as in verse 1. The wish recalls Moses' wish that all God's people were prophets (Numbers 11:29).

decisions.choice: greater: of more use to the church
decisions.reason: The last clause gives the measure: the church is built up. μείζων takes up 'the greater gifts' of 12:31.

decisions.choice: unless he interprets: the one who spoke in the tongue also interprets it
decisions.reason: διερμηνεύῃ has no stated subject. The nearest person is the one speaking in tongues, and verse 13 tells such a person to pray to interpret; verse 27 allows another to do it. Either way the condition is that the tongue is understood.

decisions.choice: I would be glad ... but gladder still
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the two wishes as lesser and greater (m1).

decisions.choice: [the speaker] (L); the speakers also interpret what they say (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Readable name the subject chosen in m3; Balanced says 'they also interpret'.

decisions.choice: kufasiri; tafsiri; mfasiri
decisions.reason: "Kufasiri" is to explain what was said so that hearers understand it, which is this gift (meaning decision); "kutafsiri" today mostly means translating a text from one language to another. The noun "tafsiri" (verse 26) and "mfasiri" (interpreter, verse 28) belong to the same family.

decisions.choice: The "unless he interprets" clause follows the comparison as a separate "ただし……" sentence
alternatives: "解き明かすのでなければ" before the comparison
decisions.reason: Japanese puts a condition before its main clause; a following "ただし" keeps Paul's order of thought (m3, uncertain).

source.text: Νῦν δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς γλώσσαις λαλῶν, τί ὑμᾶς ὠφελήσω, ἐὰν μὴ ὑμῖν λαλήσω ἢ ἐν ἀποκαλύψει ἢ ἐν γνώσει ἢ ἐν προφητείᾳ ἢ ἐν διδαχῇ;

records.literal_gloss: Now but, brothers, if I come to you in tongues speaking, what you will I benefit, if not to you I speak either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?

en.L: But now, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?
en.B: So then, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, suppose I come to you speaking in tongues. What use will I be to you, unless what I say to you brings a revelation, or knowledge, or prophecy, or teaching?
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, suppose I came to visit you and spoke only in tongues. That would not help you at all. To help you, I would need to bring you a revelation from God, or knowledge, or prophecy, or teaching.

fr.L: Mais maintenant, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, si je viens vers vous parlant en langues, à quoi vous serai-je utile, si je ne vous parle pas soit par révélation, soit par connaissance, soit par prophétie, soit par enseignement ?
fr.B: Alors, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, supposons que je vienne chez vous en parlant en langues. À quoi vous servirais-je, si ce que je vous dis ne vous apporte pas une révélation, une connaissance, une prophétie ou un enseignement ?
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, imaginez que je vienne vous voir et que je parle seulement en langues. Cela ne vous aiderait pas du tout. Pour vous aider, je devrais vous apporter une révélation de Dieu, ou une connaissance, ou une prophétie, ou un enseignement.

es.L: Pero ahora, hermanos, si voy a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} hablando en lenguas, ¿de qué {{plural_you:les|os}} aprovecharé, si no {{plural_you:les|os}} hablo o con revelación, o con conocimiento, o con profecía, o con enseñanza?
es.B: Así pues, hermanos, supongamos que voy a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}} y {{plural_you:les|os}} hablo en lenguas. ¿De qué {{plural_you:les|os}} serviré, si lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} digo no trae una revelación, o conocimiento, o profecía, o enseñanza?
es.R: Hermanos, supongamos que voy a {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}} y solo hablo en lenguas. Eso no {{plural_you:les|os}} ayudaría en nada. Para {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}}, tendría que {{plural_you:traerles|traeros}} una revelación de Dios, o conocimiento, o profecía, o enseñanza.

sw.L: Lakini sasa, ndugu, nikija kwenu nikinena kwa lugha, nitawafaidia nini, nisiposema nanyi kwa ufunuo, au kwa maarifa, au kwa unabii, au kwa mafundisho?
sw.B: Basi ndugu, tuseme ninakuja kwenu nikinena kwa lugha. Nitawafaa nini, kama maneno yangu kwenu hayaleti ufunuo, au maarifa, au unabii, au mafundisho?
sw.R: Ndugu, tuseme nilikuja kuwatembelea, nikanena kwa lugha tu. Hilo lisingewasaidia hata kidogo. Ili niwasaidie, ningehitaji kuwaletea ufunuo kutoka kwa Mungu, au maarifa, au unabii, au mafundisho.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, bây giờ nếu tôi đến với anh chị em mà nói tiếng lạ, tôi sẽ ích lợi gì cho anh chị em, nếu tôi không nói với anh chị em bằng sự mặc khải, hoặc bằng tri thức, hoặc bằng lời tiên tri, hoặc bằng sự dạy dỗ?
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, giả sử tôi đến với anh chị em và nói tiếng lạ. Tôi sẽ có ích gì cho anh chị em, nếu điều tôi nói với anh chị em không đem lại sự mặc khải, hoặc tri thức, hoặc lời tiên tri, hoặc sự dạy dỗ?
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, giả sử tôi đến thăm anh chị em và chỉ nói tiếng lạ. Điều đó sẽ chẳng giúp gì cho anh chị em cả. Muốn giúp anh chị em, tôi phải đem đến cho anh chị em một sự mặc khải từ Đức Chúa Trời, hoặc tri thức, hoặc lời tiên tri, hoặc sự dạy dỗ.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이제 내가 여러분에게 가서 방언으로 말한다면, 계시나 지식이나 예언이나 가르침으로 말하지 않는다면, 내가 여러분에게 무슨 유익을 주겠습니까?
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분에게 가서 방언으로 말한다고 합시다. 내가 하는 말이 계시나 지식이나 예언이나 가르침을 전하지 않는다면, 내가 여러분에게 무슨 도움이 되겠습니까?
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 내가 여러분을 찾아가서 방언으로만 말한다고 해 봅시다. 그것은 여러분에게 아무 도움이 되지 않을 것입니다. 여러분을 도우려면 나는 하나님께서 보여 주신 계시나, 지식이나, 예언이나, 가르침을 전해야 합니다.

pt.L: Mas agora, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, se eu for até vocês falando em línguas, em que serei útil a vocês, se eu não lhes falar com revelação, ou com conhecimento, ou com profecia, ou com ensino?
pt.B: Então, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, suponham que eu vá até vocês falando em línguas. De que eu serviria a vocês, a não ser que aquilo que eu disser traga uma revelação, ou conhecimento, ou profecia, ou ensino?
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, imaginem que eu fosse visitar vocês e falasse só em línguas. Isso não ajudaria vocês em nada. Para ajudar vocês, eu precisaria trazer uma revelação de Deus, ou conhecimento, ou profecia, ou ensino.

am.L: አሁን ግን {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በልሳኖች እየተናገርኩ ወደ እናንተ ብመጣ፣ በራእይ ወይም በእውቀት ወይም በትንቢት ወይም በትምህርት ካልተናገርኳችሁ ምን እጠቅማችኋለሁ?
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በልሳኖች እየተናገርኩ ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ እንበል። የምነግራችሁ ራእይን ወይም እውቀትን ወይም ትንቢትን ወይም ትምህርትን ካላመጣላችሁ ምን ጥቅም እሰጣችኋለሁ?
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ልጠይቃችሁ መጥቼ በልዩ ቋንቋዎች ብቻ ብናገር ምንም አልጠቅማችሁም። ልረዳችሁ ከፈለግኩ ከእግዚአብሔር የሆነ ራእይን ወይም እውቀትን ወይም ትንቢትን ወይም ትምህርትን ማምጣት አለብኝ።

hi.L: पर अब, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, यदि मैं तुम्हारे पास आकर भाषाओं में बोलूँ, तो तुम्हें क्या लाभ पहुँचाऊँगा, जब तक कि तुमसे या तो प्रकाशन से, या ज्ञान से, या भविष्यद्वाणी से, या शिक्षा से न बोलूँ?
hi.B: तो फिर, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मान लो मैं तुम्हारे पास आकर अन्य भाषाओं में बोलूँ। मैं तुम्हारे किस काम का होऊँगा, जब तक कि मेरी बात तुम्हारे लिए कोई प्रकाशन, या ज्ञान, या भविष्यद्वाणी, या शिक्षा न लाए?
hi.R: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मान लो कि मैं तुमसे मिलने आऊँ और केवल दूसरी भाषाओं में बोलूँ। इससे तुम्हें कोई लाभ नहीं होगा। तुम्हारी सहायता करने के लिए मुझे परमेश्वर की ओर से कोई प्रकाशन, या ज्ञान, या भविष्यद्वाणी, या शिक्षा लानी होगी।

ru.L: Теперь же, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, если я приду к вам, говоря на языках, какую пользу я вам принесу, если не буду говорить вам или в откровении, или в знании, или в пророчестве, или в учении?
ru.B: Итак, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, допустим, я приду к вам и буду говорить на языках. Какая вам от меня польза, если то, что я скажу, не принесёт откровения, или знания, или пророчества, или учения?
ru.R: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, допустим, я приду к вам и буду говорить только на языках. Это вам совсем не поможет. Чтобы помочь вам, мне нужно принести вам откровение от Бога, или знание, или пророчество, или учение.

uk.L: А тепер, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, якщо я прийду до вас, говорячи мовами, яку користь я вам принесу, якщо не говоритиму вам або в обʼявленні, або в знанні, або в пророцтві, або в навчанні?
uk.B: Тож, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, припустімо, я прийду до вас і говоритиму мовами. Яка вам від мене користь, якщо те, що я кажу, не принесе вам ні обʼявлення, ні знання, ні пророцтва, ні навчання?
uk.R: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, припустімо, я приїхав би до вас і говорив би лише мовами. Це вам зовсім не допомогло б. Щоб допомогти вам, я мав би принести вам обʼявлення від Бога, або знання, або пророцтво, або навчання.

ja.L: しかし今、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、もしわたしが異言で語りながらあなたがたのところに行っても、啓示によってか、知識によってか、預言によってか、教えによってかであなたがたに語らないなら、わたしはあなたがたに何の益になるでしょうか？
ja.B: ですから、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、考えてみなさい。わたしがあなたがたのところに行って、異言で語るとします。わたしの語ることが、啓示も、知識も、預言も、教えももたらさないなら、あなたがたに何の役に立つでしょうか？
ja.R: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、もしわたしがみなさんのところに行って、異言だけで話したとしましょう。それでは、みなさんのためにまったくなりません。みなさんの助けになるためには、神から示されたことか、知識か、預言か、教えを伝えなければならないのです。

decisions.choice: but now: as things are, to come to the point
decisions.reason: Νῦν here draws a conclusion, as in 12:18 and 12:20; it is not about time. Paul now applies verses 1-5 to himself.

decisions.choice: if I come: an example Paul imagines, not a planned visit
decisions.reason: Paul makes himself the test case: even an apostle speaking in tongues would do the church no good.

decisions.choice: revelation, knowledge, prophecy, teaching: kinds of speech the church can understand
alternatives: two pairs: revelation given through prophecy, and knowledge given through teaching
decisions.reason: Paul names four kinds of understandable speech. Some take them as two pairs, an inner gift and the speech that brings it out, but the Greek simply lists them with 'or'. Revelation and teaching come back in the list of verse 26; knowledge and prophecy are gifts named in 12:8-10.

decisions.choice: That would not help you at all.
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer the question expects.

decisions.choice: a revelation from God
decisions.reason: Readable says who gives the revelation.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers, as elsewhere in the letter
decisions.reason: As in English, the church is addressed as men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
decisions.reason: As 1:10: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the English gender spans in this chapter (verses 6, 20, 26, 39) have no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "sự mặc khải" for apokalypsis at every level, with "từ Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The word of the Vietnamese Galatians 1:12 (L, B); here Readable keeps it too, since it is one of a list of kinds of speech, and adds where it comes from, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: The whole church, women and men, is addressed, so the inclusive vocative is the default, as through the letter.

decisions.choice: "啓示" (L, B); "神から示されたこと" (R)
decisions.reason: Kinds of speech the church can understand (m3); R avoids the hard word "啓示".

source.text: ὅμως τὰ ἄψυχα φωνὴν διδόντα, εἴτε αὐλὸς εἴτε κιθάρα, ἐὰν διαστολὴν τοῖς φθόγγοις μὴ δῷ, πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ αὐλούμενον ἢ τὸ κιθαριζόμενον;

records.literal_gloss: Likewise the lifeless [things] a sound giving, whether flute or harp, if a distinction to the notes not they give, how will be known the being piped or the being harped?

en.L: Likewise lifeless [things] that give a sound, whether flute or harp: if they do not give a distinction in the notes, how will what is piped or what is harped be known?
en.B: Think of instruments, lifeless as they are, that give out a sound, like the flute or the harp. If their notes are not distinct, how can anyone tell what is being played on the flute or the harp?
en.R: Musical instruments like the flute and the harp are not alive, but they make sounds. If each note does not sound clear and different, no one can tell what tune is being played.

fr.L: De même, les [choses] sans vie qui rendent un son, soit flûte, soit harpe : si elles ne donnent pas de distinction aux notes, comment connaîtra-t-on ce qui est joué sur la flûte ou ce qui est joué sur la harpe ?
fr.B: Pensez aux instruments, sans vie pourtant, qui produisent un son, comme la flûte ou la harpe. Si leurs notes ne sont pas distinctes, comment reconnaîtra-t-on ce qui est joué sur la flûte ou sur la harpe ?
fr.R: Les instruments de musique comme la flûte et la harpe ne sont pas vivants, mais ils produisent des sons. Si chaque note n’est pas claire et différente des autres, personne ne peut reconnaître l’air qu’on joue.

es.L: Igualmente las [cosas] sin vida que dan sonido, sea flauta o arpa: si no dan distinción en los sonidos, ¿cómo se conocerá lo que se toca con la flauta o lo que se toca con el arpa?
es.B: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en los instrumentos, que no tienen vida pero producen sonido, como la flauta o el arpa. Si sus notas no se distinguen, ¿cómo se va a saber qué se toca en la flauta o en el arpa?
es.R: Los instrumentos musicales, como la flauta y el arpa, no tienen vida, pero producen sonidos. Si cada nota no suena clara y distinta, nadie puede saber qué melodía se está tocando.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo vitu visivyo na uhai vitoavyo sauti, kama filimbi au kinubi: visipotoa tofauti katika milio, kinachopigwa kwa filimbi au kinachopigwa kwa kinubi kitajulikanaje?
sw.B: Fikirini vyombo vya muziki, ingawa havina uhai, vinavyotoa sauti, kama filimbi au kinubi. Ikiwa milio yake haitofautiani, mtu atajuaje wimbo unaopigwa kwa filimbi au kwa kinubi?
sw.R: Vyombo vya muziki kama filimbi na kinubi havina uhai, lakini vinatoa sauti. Ikiwa kila mlio hausikiki wazi na tofauti na mwingine, hakuna mtu atakayejua ni wimbo gani unaopigwa.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, những vật vô tri phát ra âm thanh, dù là sáo hay đàn hạc, nếu không phát ra những nốt khác biệt nhau, thì làm sao biết được điều đang thổi bằng sáo hay đang gảy bằng đàn hạc?
vi.B: Hãy nghĩ đến những nhạc cụ, dù vô tri, vẫn phát ra âm thanh, như ống sáo hay đàn hạc. Nếu các nốt nhạc không rõ ràng, làm sao người ta biết được bản nhạc nào đang được thổi bằng sáo hay gảy bằng đàn hạc?
vi.R: Những nhạc cụ như ống sáo và đàn hạc không có sự sống, nhưng chúng phát ra âm thanh. Nếu mỗi nốt nhạc không vang lên rõ ràng và khác nhau, thì không ai biết được bản nhạc nào đang được chơi.

ko.L: 마찬가지로 피리나 수금처럼 소리를 내는 생명 없는 것들도 음을 구별해 내지 않으면, 피리로 부는 것인지 수금으로 타는 것인지 어떻게 알겠습니까?
ko.B: 생명이 없는 악기도 소리를 냅니다. 피리나 수금이 그렇습니다. 그런데 음이 뚜렷하게 구별되지 않으면, 피리나 수금으로 무엇을 연주하는지 어떻게 알 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 피리나 수금 같은 악기는 살아 있지 않지만 소리를 냅니다. 그러나 각 음이 분명하고 서로 다르게 들리지 않으면, 아무도 무슨 곡을 연주하는지 알 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Do mesmo modo, as coisas sem vida que dão som, seja flauta, seja harpa: se não derem distinção aos sons, como se reconhecerá o que se toca na flauta ou o que se toca na harpa?
pt.B: Pensem nos instrumentos, sem vida como são, que produzem som, como a flauta ou a harpa. Se as notas não forem distintas, como alguém vai saber o que está sendo tocado na flauta ou na harpa?
pt.R: Instrumentos musicais, como a flauta e a harpa, não têm vida, mas produzem sons. Se cada nota não soar clara e diferente das outras, ninguém consegue saber que música está sendo tocada.

am.L: እንዲሁም ድምፅ የሚያሰሙ ሕይወት የሌላቸው [ነገሮች]፣ ዋሽንትም ቢሆን በገናም ቢሆን፣ በድምፆቹ መካከል ልዩነት ባይሰጡ፣ በዋሽንት የሚነፋው ወይም በበገና የሚደረደረው እንዴት ይታወቃል?
am.B: ሕይወት ባይኖራቸውም ድምፅ የሚያወጡትን እንደ ዋሽንትና በገና ያሉትን መሣሪያዎች አስቡ። ድምፆቻቸው ተለይተው ካልተሰሙ በዋሽንቱ ወይም በበገናው የሚጫወተውን ማንም እንዴት ሊለይ ይችላል?
am.R: እንደ ዋሽንትና በገና ያሉ የሙዚቃ መሣሪያዎች ሕይወት የላቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ድምፅ ያሰማሉ። እያንዳንዱ ድምፅ ግልጽና የተለየ ሆኖ ካልተሰማ የትኛው ዜማ እንደሚጫወት ማንም ሊያውቅ አይችልም።

hi.L: इसी प्रकार निर्जीव [वस्तुएँ] भी जो आवाज़ देती हैं, चाहे बाँसुरी चाहे वीणा, यदि वे स्वरों में भेद न करें, तो जो बाँसुरी पर या वीणा पर बजाया जाता है, वह कैसे पहचाना जाएगा?
hi.B: बाजों के बारे में सोचो, जो निर्जीव होते हुए भी आवाज़ देते हैं, जैसे बाँसुरी या वीणा। यदि उनके स्वर अलग-अलग न हों, तो कोई कैसे जानेगा कि बाँसुरी या वीणा पर क्या बजाया जा रहा है?
hi.R: बाँसुरी और वीणा जैसे बाजे जीवित नहीं होते, फिर भी वे आवाज़ निकालते हैं। अगर हर स्वर साफ़ और अलग न सुनाई दे, तो कोई नहीं जान पाएगा कि कौन सी धुन बज रही है।

ru.L: Так и неодушевлённые [предметы], издающие звук, будь то свирель или арфа, — если они не дают различия в звуках, как узнать, что играют на свирели или на арфе?
ru.B: Подумайте о неживых инструментах, которые издают звук, — например, о флейте или арфе. Если их звуки не отличаются один от другого, как понять, что играют на флейте или на арфе?
ru.R: Музыкальные инструменты, например флейта и арфа, не живые, но они издают звуки. Если каждая нота не звучит ясно и отдельно, никто не поймёт, какую мелодию играют.

uk.L: Так само й бездушні [речі], що видають звук, чи сопілка, чи гусла: якщо не дадуть різниці звукам, як пізнати, що грають на сопілці чи на гуслах?
uk.B: Подумайте про інструменти, хоч вони й неживі, які видають звук, як-от сопілка чи гусла. Якщо їхні звуки не відрізняються, як можна впізнати, що грають на сопілці чи на гуслах?
uk.R: Музичні інструменти, як-от сопілка чи гусла, неживі, але вони видають звуки. Якщо кожен звук не лунає чітко й окремо, ніхто не зможе впізнати, яку мелодію грають.

ja.L: 同様に、命のないものでも、笛であれ竪琴であれ、音を出すものが、音に区別をつけないなら、笛で吹かれているものや竪琴で弾かれているものが、どうして分かるでしょうか？
ja.B: 笛や竪琴のように、命のない楽器でも音を出します。その音にはっきりした区別がなければ、何が笛で吹かれ、何が竪琴で弾かれているのか、どうして分かるでしょうか？
ja.R: 笛やたて琴のような楽器は、生きてはいませんが、音を出します。でも、一つ一つの音がはっきりと違って聞こえなければ、どんな曲が演奏されているのか、だれにも分かりません。

decisions.choice: likewise: in the same way, introducing a comparison
decisions.reason: ὅμως usually means 'nevertheless', but here, as in Galatians 3:15, it introduces a comparison, and some read it with a different accent as 'likewise'. Either way the instruments illustrate the point.

decisions.choice: flute and harp: a wind instrument and a stringed instrument of the Greek world
decisions.reason: The αὐλὸς was a reed pipe, often played in pairs, heard at feasts, weddings, funerals and in the worship of the gods. The κιθάρα was a lyre with a wooden sound box, plucked with the fingers or a pick. Paul names the most common instruments.

decisions.choice: a distinction in the notes: notes that differ from one another, so that a tune can be heard
decisions.reason: διαστολὴν is a difference or separation; φθόγγοις are musical sounds. A tune is heard only when the notes are distinct.

decisions.choice: flute, harp
decisions.reason: 'Flute' and 'harp' are the nearest instruments familiar to modern readers; m2 describes the actual instruments.

decisions.choice: no one can tell what tune is being played
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer to the question.

decisions.choice: flauta, arpa
decisions.reason: The Greek names a wind instrument and a stringed instrument (m2); "flauta" and "arpa" are the common Spanish names that give the reader the same pair, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "피리", "수금"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision names a reed pipe and a lyre; "피리" and "수금" are the names Korean uses for them, where "거문고" is a Korean zither.

decisions.choice: "ዋሽንት" (flute); "በገና" (harp, lyre)
decisions.reason: "ዋሽንት" is the shepherd's flute and "በገና" the large stringed instrument known from the Psalms, so a reader hears a wind and a stringed instrument (m2).

decisions.choice: флейта (B, R); свирель (L)
decisions.reason: The aulos was a wind instrument (meaning decision m2); Literal keeps the Bible word "свирель", and Balanced and Readable use the instrument familiar today, as the English does.

decisions.choice: сопілка, гусла
decisions.reason: The aulos was a reed pipe and the kithara a plucked stringed instrument. "Сопілка" and "гусла" are the Ukrainian folk instruments nearest to them, and read as everyday words; "арфа" is a different, larger instrument. A reviewer may prefer "флейта, ліра".

decisions.choice: "笛", "竪琴" (L, B); "たて琴" in kana (R)
decisions.reason: A wind and a stringed instrument of the Greek world (m2); "竪" is not a Jōyō kanji, so R writes it in kana.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ ἐὰν ἄδηλον φωνὴν σάλπιγξ δῷ, τίς παρασκευάσεται εἰς πόλεμον;

records.literal_gloss: Also for if an unclear sound a trumpet gives, who will prepare himself for battle?

en.L: For indeed, if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?
en.B: And if a trumpet sounds a signal no one can make out, who will prepare to fight?
en.R: In an army, a trumpet tells the soldiers to get ready for battle. But if the trumpet does not play a clear call, no one will know it is time to get ready.

fr.L: Et en effet, si une trompette rend un son indistinct, qui se préparera au combat ?
fr.B: Et si la trompette donne un signal que personne ne peut reconnaître, qui se préparera à combattre ?
fr.R: Dans une armée, la trompette annonce aux soldats qu’ils doivent se préparer au combat. Mais si la trompette ne joue pas un appel clair, personne ne saura que c’est le moment de se préparer.

es.L: Y también, si [la] trompeta da un sonido incierto, ¿quién se preparará para [la] batalla?
es.B: Y si la trompeta da un toque que nadie distingue, ¿quién se preparará para el combate?
es.R: En el ejército, la trompeta avisa a los soldados que se preparen para la batalla. Pero si la trompeta no da un toque claro, nadie sabrá que es hora de prepararse.

sw.L: Kwa maana tena, tarumbeta ikitoa sauti isiyo wazi, ni nani atakayejiandaa kwa vita?
sw.B: Na tarumbeta ikilia mlio ambao hakuna anayeweza kuutambua, ni nani atakayejiandaa kupigana?
sw.R: Jeshini, tarumbeta huwaambia askari wajiandae kwa vita. Lakini tarumbeta isipopigwa kwa mlio ulio wazi, hakuna atakayejua kwamba ni wakati wa kujiandaa.

vi.L: Và nếu kèn phát ra âm thanh không rõ ràng, thì ai sẽ chuẩn bị chiến đấu?
vi.B: Và nếu tiếng kèn thổi ra một hiệu lệnh không ai hiểu được, thì ai sẽ chuẩn bị ra trận?
vi.R: Trong quân đội, tiếng kèn báo cho binh lính biết phải chuẩn bị chiến đấu. Nhưng nếu kèn không thổi một hiệu lệnh rõ ràng, sẽ không ai biết đã đến lúc chuẩn bị.

ko.L: 나팔이 분명하지 않은 소리를 내면 누가 전쟁을 준비하겠습니까?
ko.B: 나팔이 무슨 신호인지 알 수 없는 소리를 내면, 누가 싸울 준비를 하겠습니까?
ko.R: 군대에서는 나팔 소리로 군인들에게 전투 준비를 하라고 알립니다. 그러나 나팔이 분명한 소리를 내지 않으면, 아무도 준비할 때가 된 줄 모를 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois também, se a trombeta der um som indistinto, quem se preparará para a batalha?
pt.B: E, se a trombeta der um toque que ninguém consegue reconhecer, quem vai se preparar para lutar?
pt.R: Num exército, a trombeta avisa os soldados que é hora de se preparar para a batalha. Mas, se a trombeta não tocar um sinal claro, ninguém vai saber que é hora de se preparar.

am.L: መለከትም ግልጽ ያልሆነ ድምፅ ቢያሰማ ለጦርነት ማን ይዘጋጃል?
am.B: መለከት ማንም ሊለየው የማይችል ምልክት ቢያሰማ ለውጊያ ማን ይዘጋጃል?
am.R: በሠራዊት ውስጥ መለከት ወታደሮች ለጦርነት እንዲዘጋጁ ያሳውቃል። መለከቱ ግልጽ ጥሪ ካላሰማ ግን ለመዘጋጀት ጊዜው መድረሱን ማንም አያውቅም።

hi.L: और यदि तुरही अस्पष्ट आवाज़ दे, तो कौन लड़ाई के लिए तैयारी करेगा?
hi.B: और यदि तुरही ऐसा संकेत दे जिसे कोई समझ न सके, तो कौन लड़ने को तैयार होगा?
hi.R: सेना में तुरही सिपाहियों को बताती है कि लड़ाई के लिए तैयार हो जाओ। पर अगर तुरही साफ़ आवाज़ में न बजे, तो किसी को पता नहीं चलेगा कि तैयार होने का समय आ गया है।

ru.L: И ведь если труба издаёт неясный звук, кто станет готовиться к битве?
ru.B: И если труба подаёт сигнал, который никто не может разобрать, кто будет готовиться к бою?
ru.R: В армии труба зовёт солдат готовиться к бою. Но если труба не играет ясный сигнал, никто не поймёт, что пора готовиться.

uk.L: Бо й коли сурма дасть невиразний звук, хто готуватиметься до бою?
uk.B: І якщо сурма подасть сигнал, якого ніхто не може розібрати, хто готуватиметься до бою?
uk.R: У війську сурма кличе воїнів готуватися до бою. Але якщо сурма не просурмить чітко, ніхто не знатиме, що настав час готуватися.

ja.L: 実際、もしラッパがはっきりしない音を出すなら、だれが戦いの準備をするでしょうか？
ja.B: また、ラッパが聞き分けられない合図を鳴らすなら、だれが戦いに備えるでしょうか？
ja.R: 軍隊では、ラッパが兵士たちに、戦いの準備をするように知らせます。でも、ラッパがはっきりした合図を鳴らさなければ、準備をする時が来たことは、だれにも分かりません。

decisions.choice: trumpet: an instrument used to give signals in war
decisions.reason: Armies were called to arms and given orders by trumpet calls (Numbers 10:9; Jeremiah 4:19). A call no one can recognize leaves the soldiers unprepared.

decisions.choice: who will prepare?: no one will
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer 'no one'.

decisions.choice: In an army, a trumpet tells the soldiers to get ready for battle.
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a trumpet call was for (m1) and gives the answer to the question (m2).

source.text: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς διὰ τῆς γλώσσης ἐὰν μὴ εὔσημον λόγον δῶτε, πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ λαλούμενον;

records.literal_gloss: So also you through the tongue if not a clear word you give, how will be known the being spoken?

en.L: So also you: unless you give a clear word through the tongue, how will what is spoken be known?
en.B: So with you: if your tongue does not produce speech that makes sense, how will what you say be understood?
en.R: It is like that for you too. When you speak, others need words they can understand. Otherwise they cannot tell what you mean.

fr.L: Ainsi vous aussi : si par la langue vous ne donnez pas une parole claire, comment connaîtra-t-on ce qui est dit ?
fr.B: Il en va de même pour vous : si votre langue ne produit pas des paroles qui ont un sens, comment comprendra-t-on ce que vous dites ?
fr.R: C’est la même chose pour vous. Quand vous parlez, les autres ont besoin de mots qu’ils comprennent. Sinon, ils ne peuvent pas savoir ce que vous voulez dire.

es.L: Así también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: si por medio de la lengua no {{plural_you:dan|dais}} una palabra clara, ¿cómo se conocerá lo que se dice?
es.B: Así pasa con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: si con la lengua no {{plural_you:pronuncian|pronunciáis}} palabras que se entiendan, ¿cómo se va a comprender lo que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}?
es.R: Lo mismo {{plural_you:les|os}} pasa a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Cuando {{plural_you:hablan|habláis}}, los demás necesitan palabras que puedan entender. Si no, no pueden saber qué {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} decir.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo nanyi: msipotoa neno lililo wazi kwa ulimi, kinachosemwa kitajulikanaje?
sw.B: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu: ikiwa ulimi wenu hautoi maneno yenye maana, mtu ataelewaje mnachosema?
sw.R: Ndivyo ilivyo kwenu pia. Mnaposema, wengine wanahitaji maneno wanayoweza kuyaelewa. La sivyo, hawawezi kujua mnachomaanisha.

vi.L: Anh chị em cũng vậy: nếu anh chị em không dùng lưỡi mà nói ra lời rõ ràng, thì làm sao người ta biết được điều đang nói?
vi.B: Anh chị em cũng vậy: nếu lưỡi anh chị em không nói ra những lời dễ hiểu, thì làm sao người ta hiểu được điều anh chị em nói?
vi.R: Anh chị em cũng như vậy. Khi anh chị em nói, người khác cần những lời mà họ hiểu được. Nếu không, họ không thể biết anh chị em muốn nói gì.

ko.L: 이와 같이 여러분도 혀로 분명한 말을 하지 않으면, 말하는 것을 어떻게 알겠습니까?
ko.B: 여러분도 마찬가지입니다. 여러분의 혀가 뜻이 통하는 말을 하지 않으면, 여러분이 하는 말을 어떻게 알아듣겠습니까?
ko.R: 여러분도 마찬가지입니다. 여러분이 말할 때, 다른 사람들에게는 알아들을 수 있는 말이 필요합니다. 그렇지 않으면 그들은 여러분이 무슨 뜻으로 말하는지 알 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Assim também vocês: se não derem palavra clara por meio da língua, como se saberá o que é falado?
pt.B: O mesmo acontece com vocês: se a língua de vocês não produzir palavras que façam sentido, como alguém vai entender o que vocês dizem?
pt.R: Com vocês acontece o mesmo. Quando vocês falam, os outros precisam de palavras que possam entender. Se não, eles não conseguem saber o que vocês querem dizer.

am.L: እንዲሁ እናንተም በምላስ ግልጽ ቃል ባትሰጡ የሚነገረው እንዴት ይታወቃል?
am.B: እናንተም እንዲሁ ናችሁ፤ ምላሳችሁ ትርጉም ያለው ንግግር ካላወጣ የምትሉት እንዴት ይታወቃል?
am.R: ለእናንተም እንደዚያው ነው። ስትናገሩ ሌሎች ሊረዷቸው የሚችሉ ቃላት ያስፈልጓቸዋል። አለዚያ ምን ማለታችሁ እንደ ሆነ ሊያውቁ አይችሉም።

hi.L: ऐसे ही तुम भी, यदि जीभ से साफ़ बात न कहो, तो जो कहा जाता है, वह कैसे समझा जाएगा?
hi.B: तुम्हारे साथ भी ऐसा ही है: यदि तुम्हारी जीभ से अर्थ भरी बात न निकले, तो तुम्हारी कही बात कैसे समझी जाएगी?
hi.R: तुम्हारे साथ भी ऐसा ही है। जब तुम बोलते हो, तो सुननेवालों को ऐसे शब्द चाहिए जो उनकी समझ में आएँ। नहीं तो वे नहीं जान पाएँगे कि तुम्हारा मतलब क्या है।

ru.L: Так и вы: если языком не произносите внятного слова, как узнать, что говорится?
ru.B: Так и с вами: если ваш язык не произносит понятной речи, как поймут то, что вы говорите?
ru.R: С вами то же самое. Когда вы говорите, другим нужны слова, которые они могут понять. Иначе они не поймут, что вы хотите сказать.

uk.L: Так і ви: якщо язиком не дасте зрозумілого слова, як пізнати сказане?
uk.B: Так і з вами: якщо ваш язик не вимовляє мови, яка має сенс, як зрозуміють те, що ви кажете?
uk.R: Так само і з вами. Коли ви говорите, іншим потрібні слова, які вони можуть зрозуміти. Інакше вони не збагнуть, що ви маєте на увазі.

ja.L: 同じように、あなたがたも、舌によってはっきりした言葉を出さないなら、語られていることがどうして分かるでしょうか？
ja.B: あなたがたも同じです。舌で意味の分かる言葉を語らなければ、あなたがたの言うことがどうして理解されるでしょうか？
ja.R: みなさんも同じです。話すときには、ほかの人に分かる言葉が必要です。そうでなければ、何を言いたいのか、だれにも分かりません。

decisions.choice: through the tongue: with the tongue as the organ of speech
decisions.reason: τῆς γλώσσης has the article, and 'through the tongue' fits the tongue in the mouth, as the instruments of verses 7-8 make sound. Paul may be playing on the word, which also names the gift; the point is the same either way: speech must be understood.

decisions.choice: clear: easily recognized, with a plain meaning
decisions.reason: εὔσημον means well marked, distinct, the opposite of the trumpet's unclear sound in verse 8.

decisions.choice: Otherwise they cannot tell what you mean.
alternatives: how will what is spoken be known?
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into statements.

decisions.choice: la lengua
decisions.reason: Here the word is the tongue as the organ of speech (m1). Spanish "lengua" means both the organ and a language, as the Greek word does, so the play with the gift of tongues stays visible.

decisions.choice: kwa ulimi
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word means the tongue as the organ of speech (meaning decision), so Swahili says "ulimi" (the tongue in the mouth), not "lugha", which carries the gift elsewhere in the chapter.

decisions.choice: "lưỡi" for glossa here, the organ of speech
decisions.reason: In this verse the word most likely means the tongue that speaks (m1), so Vietnamese gives the body part, not the gift; the English "through the tongue" can keep both senses, but Vietnamese has two words.

decisions.choice: "혀로" (L); "여러분의 혀가" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word here as the tongue in the mouth, the organ of speech, with the play on "tongues" left to be heard; Korean "혀" is the body part, distinct from "방언".

decisions.choice: "ምላስ" (the tongue as the organ of speech)
decisions.reason: Here the tongue is the organ of speech (m1), so Amharic uses "ምላስ"; "ልሳን" is kept for the gift of tongues.

decisions.choice: "जीभ"
decisions.reason: Here the word is the tongue as the organ of speech (meaning decision m1), so Hindi uses "जीभ", not "भाषा", the name of the gift.

decisions.choice: язик (the organ of speech)
decisions.reason: Here glōssa is the tongue as the organ of speech (m1), so Ukrainian says "язик" and not "мова", the word kept for the gift.

decisions.choice: "舌" (L, B), not "異言"
decisions.reason: Here the word is the tongue as the organ of speech (m1, uncertain); Japanese has to choose, and "舌" keeps the picture of the instruments.

source.text: ἔσεσθε γὰρ εἰς ἀέρα λαλοῦντες.

records.literal_gloss: You will be for into air speaking.

en.L: For you will be speaking into [the] air.
en.B: You will be speaking to empty air.
en.R: Your words will be wasted, like talking to the wind.

fr.L: Car vous parlerez dans l’air.
fr.B: Vous parlerez dans le vide.
fr.R: Vos paroles seront perdues, comme si vous parliez au vent.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} hablando al aire.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estarán|Estaréis}} hablando al vacío.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sus palabras|Vuestras palabras}} se perderán, como si {{plural_you:hablaran|hablarais}} al viento.

sw.L: Kwa maana mtakuwa mkisema hewani.
sw.B: Mtakuwa mnaongea na hewa tupu.
sw.R: Maneno yenu yatapotea bure, kama kuongea na upepo.

vi.L: Vì anh chị em sẽ nói vào không khí.
vi.B: Anh chị em sẽ nói vào khoảng không.
vi.R: Lời anh chị em nói sẽ thành vô ích, như nói với gió.

ko.L: 여러분은 허공에 대고 말하는 것이 될 것입니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 허공에 대고 말하는 셈이 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 여러분의 말은 바람에 대고 말하는 것처럼 헛될 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois vocês estarão falando ao ar.
pt.B: Vocês estarão falando para o vazio.
pt.R: As palavras de vocês vão ser desperdiçadas, como quem fala ao vento.

am.L: ለአየር የምትናገሩ ትሆናላችሁና።
am.B: ለባዶ አየር የምትናገሩ ትሆናላችሁ።
am.R: ቃላችሁ ከንቱ ይሆናል፤ ለነፋስ እንደ መናገር ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम हवा से बातें करनेवाले ठहरोगे।
hi.B: तुम ख़ाली हवा से बातें कर रहे होगे।
hi.R: तुम्हारे शब्द बेकार जाएँगे, जैसे कोई हवा से बातें करे।

ru.L: Ведь вы будете говорить на воздух.
ru.B: Вы будете говорить в пустоту.
ru.R: Ваши слова пропадут зря, как будто вы говорите с ветром.

uk.L: Бо ви будете говорити на вітер.
uk.B: Ви говоритимете в порожнечу.
uk.R: Ваші слова будуть марні, як розмова з вітром.

ja.L: あなたがたは空気に向かって語る者となるからです。
ja.B: あなたがたは、むなしく空に向かって語ることになるのです。
ja.R: みなさんの言葉は、風に向かって話すように、むだになってしまいます。

decisions.choice: speaking into the air: talking to no purpose
decisions.reason: Like 'beating the air' (9:26), the phrase describes effort that reaches no one.

decisions.choice: like talking to the wind
decisions.reason: Readable uses a familiar picture for words that reach no one.

decisions.choice: dans l’air (L); dans le vide (B)
decisions.reason: French "parler en l’air" means to talk thoughtlessly or make empty promises, not to speak to no purpose (m1). "Parler dans le vide" is the French idiom for words that reach no one; Literal keeps the air.

decisions.choice: hablar al aire (L); hablar al vacío (B); como si hablaran al viento (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means speaking to no purpose (m1). Literal keeps "al aire"; Balanced says "al vacío", the Spanish for empty air; Readable says the words are lost, "como si hablaran al viento", as the English "like talking to the wind".

decisions.choice: como quem fala ao vento
decisions.reason: "Falar ao vento" is the Portuguese idiom for words that reach no one, close to the Greek picture of the air (m1), as the English Readable uses "talking to the wind".

decisions.choice: на вітер
decisions.reason: The Greek "into the air" means to no purpose (m1); "говорити на вітер" is the matching Ukrainian idiom, and keeps the picture of air.

source.text: τοσαῦτα εἰ τύχοι γένη φωνῶν εἰσιν ἐν κόσμῳ, καὶ οὐδὲν ἄφωνον·

records.literal_gloss: So many, if it may happen, kinds of sounds there are in [the] world, and nothing [is] without sound;

en.L: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in [the] world, and none [is] without meaning;
en.B: Who knows how many languages there are in the world? And not one of them is without meaning.
en.R: There are many, many languages in the world, and every one of them means something to the people who speak it.

fr.L: Il y a, peut-être, tant de sortes de langages dans le monde, et aucun [n’est] sans signification ;
fr.B: Qui sait combien il y a de langages dans le monde ? Et aucun n’est dépourvu de sens.
